name: com.printoncommand/mcp
title: Print on Command
description: Order printed posters and canvases. Agents proof artwork; a human pays a link.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List every product in the catalog in summary form: ID, name, type, sizes, options such as frame colour, and item price range, with the flat shipping charge per order. Optionally filter by product type.

type.description: Only list products of this type.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get everything needed to customise one product: its variants with sizes, options such as frame colour, and item prices, the flat shipping charge per order, and its print specs such as DPI and file requirements.

product_id.description: A product ID from list_products, starting with "product_".

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Get somewhere to send an artwork file. Returns an upload ID, an address to send a PNG or JPEG file to, and a browser link a human can use instead. Both links last one hour.

tools.name: create_proof
tools.description: Place uploaded artwork on a product variant. Returns a permanent proof ID, a preview image link and the result of the DPI check.

variant_id.description: A variant ID of that product, starting with "variant_".

upload_id.description: An upload ID from create_upload, starting with "upload_". The file must already be uploaded.

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: Look up an existing proof: its product and variant, preview image link and DPI check result.

proof_id.description: A proof ID from create_proof, starting with "proof_".

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create an order for one or more items to one US address, and get its order page for the human. Each item is a proof and a quantity; list each proof once. Shipping is a flat charge once per order, however many items. Returns each item with its product, variant, item price and line total, then the subtotal, shipping, total, order_url and an order token. Share order_url with the person paying: it shows the proofs, items, prices and status, and its Pay securely button takes them to checkout. Nothing is charged until they pay. Retrying with the same idempotency key and the same items and address returns the same order and token; the same key with any different detail, including a changed item list, is an error. An order not paid within its payment window becomes payment_expired; then call create_order again with a new idempotency key.

items.description: The items to print, each a different proof with its quantity. Posters and canvases can share an order. Shipping is charged once for the whole order.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key you choose for this order, such as a UUID. Reuse it when retrying.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Follow an order: its order token, its status, and each item with its proof ID, product, variant, quantity, prices, its own status and its own tracking numbers. Items made by different printers can ship separately, so read each item's tracking_numbers; the order is shipped only once every item has shipped. It also returns order_url, the order page to share with the person paying; while the order awaits payment they pay from there. A payment_expired order cannot be paid; call create_order again with a new idempotency key.

order_token.description: The order token from create_order, starting with "order_".

tools.name: report_order_problem
tools.description: Report something wrong with an order, such as damage, the wrong item or an order that never arrived. Returns instructions for emailing support. Pass order_token to have it written into the instructions, and proof_id when the problem is with one item of the order.

order_token.description: Optional. The order token from create_order, starting with "order_".

proof_id.description: Optional. The proof ID of the item with the problem, as listed on the order, when only some items are affected.

tools.name: report_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback about this service, such as something confusing, an unclear error or a missing product or feature. Returns a feedback ID.
